name: Synapse
source:
In Synapse City, an emotional monitoring system called SEC measures the feelings of every citizen in real time. Stress, loneliness, desire — all of it feeds into a rank score that determines housing, access, and survival.

The protagonist is a former Synapse engineer who left the department under unclear circumstances and now lives alone in a Tier 2 apartment, watching his rank slowly decline. To keep his housing he needs to solve two problems — poverty and loneliness — before the system decides he no longer qualifies for Tier 2 access.

He takes a risky job for a local fixer to earn some credits. The job goes well. Shortly after, someone breaks into his apartment while he sleeps and leaves a message on the wall.
He has 48 hours to fix his mistake. He doesn't know yet that this is only the beginning.
translation:
在Synapse City，一个名为SEC的情绪监测系统实时测量每个公民的感受。压力、孤独、欲望——所有这些都会影响排名分数，决定住房、访问和生存。

主角是一名前Synapse工程师，在不明情况下离开了部门，现在独自住在二层公寓里，看着自己的等级慢慢下降。为了保住他的住房，他需要解决两个问题——贫困和孤独——然后系统就会决定他不再符合二级准入资格。

他为当地的修理工做了一份危险的工作来赚取一些学分。工作进展顺利。不久之后，有人趁他睡觉时闯入他的公寓，并在墙上留下了一条信息。
他有48小时的时间来纠正他的错误。他还不知道这只是开始。
